args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary: Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods highlighted a 2026 outlook piece on cold-chain logistics, linking to an in-depth article and a companion analysis.
- Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots using this live data-sharing approach cut insurance/logistics claims by a quarter (registered with jonas.moreau@northwind.example to access).
